description: Obszary zagrożone powodzią od wód gruntowych (podtopienia) is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Polish Geological Institute - National Research Institute. Areas susceptible to groundwater flooding (inundation). Coverage: Polish Geological Institute - National Research Institute. The portal shows the English title as "Areas susceptible to groundwater flooding" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Polish Geological Institute - National Research Institute. Its keywords include geologia, hydrogeologia, podtopienia. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XML, HTML. The listing shows 2023-11-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
